thread:
kevin: Customer ticket — duplicate billing when stream retried after route fallback. short trace pasted.

kevin: ```
2026-04-02T12:07:10Z stream start session=sess-71 prefix=96
2026-04-02T12:07:11Z sidecar-A invokes toolcall tc-23 -> client timeout
2026-04-02T12:07:11Z sidecar-A emits provisional meter(lrid=?,tokens=30,route=us-east-1)
2026-04-02T12:07:12Z router falls back to us-west-2; client reconnect resume=rt-71
2026-04-02T12:07:13Z sidecar-B retries toolcall tc-23' and emits confirmed meter(lrid=?,tokens=30,route=us-west-2)
Ledger shows both provisional and confirmed -> billed 60 tokens
```

maria: Looks like LRID wasn't stable / not propagated. sidecar-B couldn't find provisional to update.

sasha: Two fixes: 1) return a server-generated LRID on the stream handshake and require it on subsequent meter events; 2) ledger dedupe/update by lrid so final replaces provisional.

anita: For quotas, provisional should act as "reserved" (reduces concurrency/quota) but not be included in invoices until confirmed. That prevents quota exhaustion surprises.

alex: Console UX: default hide provisionals. Add a "Show pending" toggle and status column (pending/confirmed). Also add a small tooltip explaining "reserved vs billed."

maria: Telemetry fields to add: lrid, provisional(bool), provisional_ts, resume_token_hash, origin_route, final_attribution_route, final_token_count. We'll version the meter proto.

sasha: Edge case: client may reuse resume tokens across unrelated requests. LRID must be issued per logical request and returned in handshake; clients may echo it but server is authoritative.

anita: Operational: backfill job to merge provisionals older than 24h where final exists; emit alerts for unmerged rows > 7d. I'll scope cost.

kevin: Action items: proto change (maria), router/sidecar LRID plumbing (sasha), ledger index/update-by-lrid (ops), console default-filter + toggle (alex), backfill job (anita). Billing/legal to confirm "reserved vs billed" semantics.

ops-bot: canary deployed: meter-proto-v3 rolled to 3% traffic at 2026-04-02T12:09:00Z

alex: QA: add synthetic tests that simulate fallback + delayed finalizer + GC. Also add invoice test to ensure only confirmed tokens appear.

maria: will include provisional_row_id_hint in final event for debugging and provisional_ts for race analysis.

sasha: tiny add: final event should include provisional_ts and provisional_route when available so reconciliation can be fuzzy-matched if lrid missing.

kevin: great. I'll open tickets and link this thread. Thanks all :thumbsup:
